stories.summary: Run a synchronous static scan of the exact packed run bundle before the run-start preflight returns, recording the scanner version and image digest, and executing the scanner container with no network access and a failed record when it writes no report

Reuse a completed static scan result only when stage, content bundle and scanner version match, scan again when content or scanner version changes, and never reuse a failed scan while reusing a completed failing result

Compute one static verdict from the scanner report: pass only with a non-DO_NOT_INSTALL recommendation, no critical finding and complete coverage, recording each blocking reason and never letting an accepted finding clear a block
Enforce a fixed ten-minute limit on the static scan, kill a container still running at the limit, and record the scan as failed with verdict fail and the reason Scan exceeded the ten-minute limit.
Show the static scan report with verdict, score, recommendation, coverage, every finding's severity, rule, file and line, an in-progress state, and a not-found response for an unknown scan id

Let a project member start a static-only scan from the skill page without creating a run, using BSB-22's shared project-membership check, refusing non-members, and resolving no integration or credential

Prove the builder's static verdict equals the platform's for the same bundle and pinned scanner version across a fixed corpus, recording scanner version and image digest and failing loudly on a version mismatch or missing baseline
